AI INFRASTRUCTURE / API INTEGRATION

Connect agent clients to Claude Code.

An API adapter that lets existing applications work with Claude Code while retaining streamed responses and multi-step conversations.

ProjectClaudegate
ScopePublic implementation
StackPython · FastAPI · Claude Agent SDK · SSE

The problem

Agent clients and the Claude Code CLI expose different interfaces. A useful bridge has to translate messages, stream responses, return tool calls and keep follow-up requests attached to the right conversation.

My contribution

  • Built the OpenAI-compatible request and response layer around Claude Code.
  • Implemented streamed output, tool-result continuation, image and file inputs, and session reuse.
  • Added authentication, structured logs, metrics and credential-free tests using a fake CLI.

How the system works

Agent clientChat APISession lookupClaude CodeStream or tool call

Keep the client interface familiar. Applications can use a chat-completions interface. Configuration examples cover Hermes Agent and OpenClaw.

Preserve conversation continuity. Follow-up requests can reuse a live session; request history provides a recovery path when the original session is gone.

Test the integration boundary. A fake CLI exercises the gateway without credentials. Deployment smoke checks separately test real streaming, tools, images and session behavior.

What you can verify

The public package includes a server command, a configuration doctor, health and model endpoints, metrics, and integration documentation. Reviewers can inspect both the adapter and its test suite.

Source repositoryAgent client integration

Scope & limitations

Requires an installed and authenticated Claude Code CLI. Compatibility is documented per feature; the gateway does not implement every OpenAI parameter. Coding-agent execution requires restricted access and an appropriate service account.
